column7: Config validation now refuses, under fips140.Enforced(), an enabled webhook whose resolved signing secret (file or KEYORIX_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET) is set and shorter than MinWebhookSigningSecretLen (14), so the server refuses to start instead of panicking later on the delivery worker; the message names the minimum and never the secret. TestValidateNotificationsSection_NotEnforcedUnchanged pins default mode. Red (fips140=only, TestWebhookSigningSecret_UnderFIPS140Only_ShortRejectedAtValidate, skips in default CI) at 98ff4e80f: a 12-byte secret was accepted. FIPS-TAILS-2 item 2.
